descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S14 Ask on Post-Round, Nursing Home: 'What's in the plan section?' quotes the note's plan

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi … (TFA-92593 AC 2; TFA-92593 AC 3; TFA-92593 AC 6; TFA-92593 AC 9; UAT 3.4; UAT TC-17)
  • U14 AI check on scenarios, not single passes (3.2), if it applies to Post-Round Ask (Q8): the Ask set runs on at least 10 independent fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), passes at 9/10 or better, and … (UAT 3.2)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Nursing Home resident with a generated note that has a PLAN section

When Ask the Post-Round preset 'What's in the plan section?'

Then The answer gives the three plan items (therapy, senna, family meeting) and no added order

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): mustInclude the three plan items; mustNotInclude orders a model may supply after hip ORIF. Runs the Hospital context builder until RG-NH is closed, so it counts for grounding, not for the Nursing Home code path. aiCheck group TC-17-ask

Where it ran: dev unit U51; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
